benchmarks.name: DOCKING_P53_APRIL_VINA_AFFINITY_BOUNDED
benchmarks.description: Redocking a ligand to p53 DNA-binding domain must produce a finite binding affinity within a sane range.
benchmarks.ground_truth: AutoDock Vina affinities for organic ligands are typically -4 to -12 kcal/mol.
benchmarks.citation: Trott O., Olson A.J. J. Comput. Chem. 2010 (AutoDock Vina).
